_source: Reproduces the single-file (dashed) curves in fig:1D_vs_2D (panels a-c) of the JCP 2026 paper, w_pore = 8 A (accessible diameter). Symmetric RPM electrolyte, T=400K, epsr=20, ion diameter 5A, mu_IL/2 = -0.2975 eV plus the confinement free-energy shift psi (image-charge/wall integral over the 3D->1D dimensional reduction) for wall_atom_r_A=1.685A.

_units.r_pore_A: Angstrom (nominal pore radius: radius to the centre of the wall atoms)
_units.eshift_A: Angstrom (inward shift of the image-charge screening surface relative to r_pore_A)
_units.wall_atom_r_A: Angstrom (physical wall-atom radius; r_pore_A - wall_atom_r_A is the accessible radius used for the charge/capacitance surface-area normalization)
_units.ions.mu_eV: eV (mu_IL/2 + psi, the confinement-corrected per-ion chemical potential)
